modules.title: Recruitment & Admission Management

objective.title: Ensure effective and accountable Recruitment & Admission Management
objective.description: Provide validated, secure and auditable institutional processes for Recruitment & Admission Management.

activities.title: Application Intake
activities.description: Manage Application Intake within Recruitment & Admission Management.

requirements.title: Recruitment Cycle Configuration
requirements.description: The system shall allow authorized Admission Administrators to configure recruitment cycles, including intake name, academic year, application opening and closing dates, applicable academic or police training programs, intake capacity, and publication status. The system shall validate date ranges, prevent conflicting active recruitment cycles for the same program and intake category unless an authorized exception is recorded, and preserve configuration change history. Applicants shall only be permitted to submit applications against published and currently open recruitment cycles.
requirements.acceptance_criteria:
1. An authorized Admission Administrator can create, edit, and publish a recruitment cycle.
2. Intake name, academic year, applicable program, opening date, and closing date are required.
3. Closing date must be later than opening date.
4. Conflicting active recruitment cycles are rejected unless an authorized exception is recorded.
5. Applicants can select only published recruitment cycles within their valid application periods.
6. Unauthorized users cannot modify recruitment cycle configuration.
7. Changes to recruitment cycle configuration are traceable through the audit mechanism.
8. Existing submitted applications remain associated with their original recruitment cycle.

requirements.title: Applicant Registration
requirements.description: The system shall allow applicants or authorized Admission Officers to register an application against an open recruitment cycle. The application shall capture the applicant's full name, identification reference, contact information, intended program, and required applicant declarations. Each submitted application shall receive a unique application reference.
requirements.acceptance_criteria:
1. Registration is available only for published and open recruitment cycles.
2. Mandatory applicant information is validated before submission.
3. A unique application reference is generated for each submitted application.
4. Unauthorized staff cannot create applications on behalf of applicants.
5. Application creation and submission are auditable.

requirements.title: Applicant Identity Verification
requirements.description: The system shall support verification of applicant identity using institutionally accepted identification documents. Authorized screening personnel shall record verification results, discrepancies, verification dates, and supporting evidence without overwriting the original submitted identity information.
requirements.acceptance_criteria:
1. An applicant's identification reference is recorded.
2. Authorized personnel can record verified, pending, or discrepant identity outcomes.
3. Identity discrepancies prevent final eligibility clearance until resolved.
4. Original submitted identity details remain traceable.
5. Unauthorized users cannot approve identity verification.

requirements.title: Supporting Document Upload
requirements.description: The system shall allow applicants to upload required supporting documents according to the selected recruitment cycle and program. Document categories, permitted formats, maximum file sizes, and mandatory document rules shall be configurable. Uploaded documents shall be associated with the application and protected against unauthorized access.
requirements.acceptance_criteria:
1. Required document categories are displayed for the selected recruitment cycle.
2. File type and size restrictions are enforced.
3. Mandatory documents are checked before final submission.
4. Applicants can view their own uploaded documents.
5. Access to another applicant's documents is denied without authorization.
6. Document replacement history is retained.

requirements.title: Draft Application Management
requirements.description: The system shall allow applicants to save incomplete applications as drafts and resume editing before final submission. Draft applications shall not enter eligibility screening. Submission shall require successful validation of all mandatory fields and documents.
requirements.acceptance_criteria:
1. Applicants can save and reopen their own drafts.
2. Drafts remain editable while the recruitment cycle permits editing.
3. Draft applications are excluded from screening queues.
4. Submission validates required fields and documents.
5. Submitted applications cannot be silently reverted to draft.

requirements.title: Duplicate Application Prevention
requirements.description: The system shall detect potentially duplicate applications using the applicant identification reference and recruitment cycle. Duplicate submissions shall be blocked or referred for authorized resolution according to institutional policy, without automatically deleting existing application records.
requirements.acceptance_criteria:
1. Duplicate checks execute before final submission.
2. Exact duplicate identification references within the same recruitment cycle are flagged.
3. Applicants receive a clear duplicate warning without disclosure of another person's private information.
4. Authorized personnel can investigate suspected duplicates.
5. Duplicate resolution decisions are recorded.

requirements.title: Submission Deadline Enforcement
requirements.description: The system shall enforce the recruitment cycle opening and closing dates when accepting applications. Application submission timestamps shall use a consistent server-side time reference. Any late-submission exception shall require explicit authorization and a recorded justification.
requirements.acceptance_criteria:
1. Applications cannot be submitted before the opening date.
2. Applications cannot be submitted after the closing deadline without an authorized exception.
3. Deadline validation is enforced server-side.
4. Authorized late-submission exceptions include a reason and responsible user.
5. Submission timestamps are preserved.

requirements.title: Application Acknowledgement
requirements.description: The system shall generate an acknowledgement when an application is successfully submitted. The acknowledgement shall contain the application reference, recruitment cycle, submission date, and current application status. Notification delivery shall not create duplicate applications.
requirements.acceptance_criteria:
1. Successful submission generates an acknowledgement.
2. The acknowledgement includes the unique application reference.
3. Applicants can retrieve their acknowledgement.
4. A notification failure does not duplicate the application.
5. Acknowledgement generation is traceable.

requirements.title: Application Correction Requests
requirements.description: Authorized Admission Officers shall be able to return submitted applications for specified corrections, including a written explanation and correction deadline where applicable. Applicants shall be allowed to edit only the permitted fields and resubmit the corrected application while preserving the original submission and correction history.
requirements.acceptance_criteria:
1. Only authorized personnel can request corrections.
2. Every correction request includes a reason.
3. Applicants can view the requested corrections.
4. Only permitted fields are editable during correction.
5. Resubmission preserves the original application reference.
6. Correction and resubmission history is retained.

requirements.title: Application Status Tracking
requirements.description: The system shall maintain a traceable application status history from draft through submission, screening, selection, and final admission outcome. Applicants shall see only their own application status, while authorized Admission Officers may access relevant applications according to assigned responsibilities.
requirements.acceptance_criteria:
1. Current application status is available to the applicant.
2. Status transitions follow authorized workflow rules.
3. Every transition records the responsible actor and timestamp.
4. Applicants cannot directly modify screening or selection decisions.
5. Authorized officers can filter applications by status and recruitment cycle.
6. Historical statuses remain accessible for audit.

activities.title: Eligibility Screening
activities.description: Manage Eligibility Screening within Recruitment & Admission Management.

requirements.title: Eligibility Criteria Configuration
requirements.description: The system shall allow authorized Admission Administrators to configure recruitment eligibility criteria by cycle and program, including educational qualifications, permitted age ranges, required documents, and institutionally approved special conditions. Published criteria shall be versioned and applied consistently during screening.
requirements.acceptance_criteria:
1. Authorized administrators can configure criteria for a recruitment cycle and program.
2. Minimum and maximum values are validated.
3. Published criteria are available to screening officers.
4. Changes after publication require authorization and justification.
5. Previous criteria versions remain traceable.

requirements.title: Applicant Document Verification
requirements.description: Authorized Screening Officers shall verify submitted supporting documents against the applicable recruitment requirements. Each document shall receive a verification outcome and, where necessary, a discrepancy explanation. Rejected or unverifiable mandatory documents shall prevent eligibility clearance until resolved.
requirements.acceptance_criteria:
1. Officers can review documents assigned to them.
2. Each mandatory document has a verification outcome.
3. Rejected documents require written reasons.
4. Unresolved mandatory document discrepancies block final clearance.
5. Verification actions retain actor and timestamp.

requirements.title: Age Eligibility Validation
requirements.description: The system shall calculate applicant age using the date of birth and the reference date specified in the recruitment criteria. It shall evaluate the applicant against the configured age limits and identify cases requiring authorized exception review without automatically changing the applicant's recorded date of birth.
requirements.acceptance_criteria:
1. Age calculation uses the configured reference date.
2. Applicants outside the permitted age range are flagged.
3. Invalid or missing birth dates prevent automatic clearance.
4. Authorized exceptions require a reason and decision record.
5. Original birth date information remains traceable.

requirements.title: Educational Qualification Verification
requirements.description: Authorized Screening Officers shall verify educational qualifications against program-specific admission requirements. Verification shall include qualification level, issuing institution, completion status, and available supporting evidence. Unverified qualifications shall not be treated as confirmed eligibility.
requirements.acceptance_criteria:
1. Program-specific qualification rules are applied.
2. Qualification verification outcomes are recorded.
3. Missing mandatory evidence prevents final clearance.
4. Discrepancies require explanatory remarks.
5. Only authorized officers can confirm qualifications.

requirements.title: Screening Officer Assignment
requirements.description: The system shall allow authorized Admission Supervisors to assign applications to Screening Officers based on recruitment cycle, program, and workload. Reassignment shall preserve previous assignments and their history. Officers shall access only applications permitted by their assigned responsibilities.
requirements.acceptance_criteria:
1. Supervisors can assign eligible screening personnel.
2. Assignment records include officer and timestamp.
3. Reassignment retains previous assignment history.
4. Unauthorized officers cannot modify unassigned applications.
5. Supervisors can review screening workloads.

requirements.title: Eligibility Screening Decisions
requirements.description: Assigned Screening Officers shall record eligibility assessments and supporting findings for each applicant. The system shall distinguish eligible, ineligible, and pending-verification outcomes and prevent unsupported final decisions where mandatory checks remain incomplete.
requirements.acceptance_criteria:
1. Screening outcomes are recorded against the applicant.
2. Ineligible decisions require reasons.
3. Mandatory checks must be completed before final clearance.
4. Pending-verification applications remain unresolved.
5. Screening decisions retain officer identity and timestamp.

requirements.title: Screening Discrepancy Recording
requirements.description: The system shall allow Screening Officers to record discrepancies involving applicant identity, submitted documents, qualifications, or other eligibility evidence. Each discrepancy shall have a category, description, resolution status, and associated supporting evidence.
requirements.acceptance_criteria:
1. Officers can create categorized discrepancy records.
2. Each discrepancy includes a description.
3. Open discrepancies remain visible during screening.
4. Resolution requires authorized action and supporting remarks.
5. Closed discrepancies remain available in the audit history.

requirements.title: Applicant Correction Requests
requirements.description: Authorized Screening Officers shall request corrections or additional evidence from applicants when eligibility information is incomplete or inconsistent. Correction requests shall identify the affected information, required action, and applicable deadline. Resubmission shall preserve the original screening evidence.
requirements.acceptance_criteria:
1. Correction requests identify the required action.
2. Applicants can view requests relating to their own applications.
3. Correction deadlines are enforced where configured.
4. Resubmitted information is linked to the original request.
5. Screening history is preserved after correction.

requirements.title: Screening Outcome Approval
requirements.description: The system shall route completed screening outcomes to an authorized Admission Supervisor for verification and approval. Supervisors may approve the outcome or return it for correction with remarks. Screening Officers shall not approve their own screening decisions when separation of duties is required.
requirements.acceptance_criteria:
1. Only completed screening outcomes can be submitted for approval.
2. Authorized supervisors can approve or return decisions.
3. Returned decisions require remarks.
4. Separation-of-duties rules are enforced where configured.
5. Approved outcomes cannot be silently modified.
6. Approval actions are auditable.

requirements.title: Screening Audit History
requirements.description: The system shall maintain an immutable history of screening assignments, eligibility checks, discrepancies, correction requests, decisions, and approvals. Authorized auditors and supervisors shall be able to retrieve the history without modifying the underlying events.
requirements.acceptance_criteria:
1. Screening actions record actor, timestamp, and action type.
2. Historical decisions remain accessible after corrections.
3. Audit history cannot be edited through ordinary screening operations.
4. Access to audit history is permission-controlled.
5. Audit records can be retrieved for an individual application.

activities.title: Entrance Assessment
activities.description: Manage Entrance Assessment within Recruitment & Admission Management.

requirements.title: Register entrance assessment
requirements.description: The system shall allow the Examination Coordinator to create a entrance assessment with assessment paper, venue, candidate, attendance and marks. The record must be linked to its governing institutional reference and receive a unique identifier before it can advance to moderated assessment result.
requirements.acceptance_criteria: An authorized Examination Coordinator can save all required fields; missing identifiers and invalid references are rejected; a unique record reference is returned.

requirements.title: Validate entrance assessment eligibility
requirements.description: Before accepting a entrance assessment, the system shall evaluate candidate eligibility, mark range and timetable clashes. Failures must identify the violated rule without exposing unrelated personal records, and the record must remain in a nonfinal state.
requirements.acceptance_criteria: The configured checks run on the server; failing records cannot advance; the reason and rule version are visible to authorized staff.

requirements.title: Assign entrance assessment responsibility
requirements.description: The system shall assign each entrance assessment to an authorized responsible officer or committee for the next stage toward moderated assessment result. Assignment shall record the assignee, assigning officer, timestamp and reassignment reason.
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Only users with the correct responsibility can be assigned; an unassigned record cannot be actioned by unauthorized staff; reassignment history is preserved.

requirements.title: Review entrance assessment evidence
requirements.description: The assigned reviewer shall examine the entrance assessment and supporting information (assessment paper, venue, candidate, attendance and marks), record findings and identify missing or inconsistent evidence before recommending a decision.
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Reviewers can record findings against the correct record; incomplete evidence produces an actionable finding; review history remains available.

requirements.title: Request entrance assessment correction
requirements.description: An authorized reviewer shall return a entrance assessment for correction with a written reason, affected fields and response deadline where applicable. Corrections must preserve the previous submitted values and all review comments.
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Correction requests specify affected information; the responsible user can resubmit only permitted fields; the original submission and reviewer comments remain accessible.

requirements.title: Approve entrance assessment outcome
requirements.description: The designated approver shall decide whether the entrance assessment can proceed to moderated assessment result, using candidate eligibility, mark range and timetable clashes and completed review findings. A decision must record approval, return or rejection, the actor and decision rationale.
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Only authorized approvers can decide; unresolved mandatory findings block approval; every decision is time-stamped and immutable in history.

requirements.title: Publish entrance assessment result
requirements.description: After required approval, the system shall publish or release the authorized entrance assessment result to the appropriate recipients, while keeping restricted details inaccessible to unauthorized users.
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Unapproved records cannot be published; recipients see only permitted fields; publication time and responsible actor are recorded.

requirements.title: Track entrance assessment lifecycle
requirements.description: The system shall show the current state and chronological history of each entrance assessment, including creation, validation, assignment, review, correction, approval and release toward moderated assessment result.
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Status transitions follow the configured workflow; every transition has actor and time; the history cannot be silently overwritten.

requirements.title: Report entrance assessment exceptions
requirements.description: Authorized supervisors shall filter and export exceptions for entrance assessment records, including failed checks (candidate eligibility, mark range and timetable clashes), overdue reviews and unresolved corrections, without exposing records outside their access scope.
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Filters identify unresolved and overdue cases; report totals reconcile to permitted records; export permissions and access events are logged.

requirements.title: Audit entrance assessment changes
requirements.description: The system shall preserve an audit trail for changes to entrance assessment information (assessment paper, venue, candidate, attendance and marks), including old and new values, responsible actor, timestamp and decision references, while protecting restricted evidence.
requirements.acceptance_criteria: An auditor can trace each material change to an actor and source record; ordinary users cannot edit audit events; restricted data follows access controls.
